blind.description: A low dry-stone wall section topped with vertically set coping stones ('cock and hen' style). The lower section consists of horizontally stacked, rounded and irregular grey fieldstones with beige mortar or packing in gaps. The top row consists of upright, rectangular or rounded stones set side-by-side with patches of green moss covering their top edges. The geometry is solid, continuous, and stylized, with clean sculpted surfaces and no floating debris or detached artifacts. The bottom is flat and rests directly on the ground without an integrated base or extra slab.
blind.from_above: A horizontal rectangular strip showing a row of vertical stone tops capped with green moss, flanked by slight irregularities of the stones beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 0.45 times the height of the figure (around 2.5 ft tall) and about 1.2 times as wide as the figure is tall (approx. 7 ft long).
